audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 rows of the level chart disagree between the full layer (phases[N].side) and the content layer (win[N]): phases has Morgana/Morgana/Morgana/Skill/Skill/Sona/Sona while win[] has Skill/Skill/Skill/Morgana/Morgana/Morgana/Morgana. The content whys[] narrative (even early, Morgana takes over at 4-5-6-late) matches win[], so win[] is correct and phases.side is stale.
audit.why: A reader who opens the level chart and the paragraph beneath it gets two different answers to 'who wins Level 1' — the exact defect the mirror/chart rules exist to prevent.
audit.corrected: See edits — every phases[N].side moved to match its already-correct win[N], with ratings adjusted to keep an even Skill row at ~5/10 and a Morgana-favored row at 6-7/10.

audit.why: Even skill lane through level 3, Morgana takes over from 4 onward once Black Shield answers Crescendo and Dark Binding punishes Sona's lack of a dash — content's early/mid/late narrative already states this correctly.
Level 6 (Black Shield voids Crescendo), first item (Q lands reliably, Sona has no dash), and late R Shackles vs her squishy body are the real spikes and are already captured in spikes[] and phases[].

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: Sona's Crescendo is 140s at rank 1, 100s maxed — spread the instant she starts channeling and it whiffs. Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed — answers one Crescendo per cooldown, not chip poke. Save your R for the swing moment only.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Dark Binding is 10s cooldown, 1250 range — bank it and commit when your carry can follow up.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield breaks the instant Crescendo lands on it — save the barrier for the stun, not her Q poke.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

notes: Fixed a full/content level-chart disagreement across all 7 rows (see point-4 audit entry) plus the lint-flagged COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT, both COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets, and the MISGENDER hit in report[8].t.
